newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Datum started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Datum started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage on Datum Inc with a buy rating based on its view that Datum, a provider of timing products for space, scientific and industrial measurement applications, will see strong growth in the personal communications services market.
-- H&Q also sees strong possibilities for growth in international and original equipment manufacturer businesses.
-- It estimates March quarter earnings for Datum at $0.19 a share on revenue of $27.1 million, and full year 1997 earnings of $0.89 a share on revenues of $115.1 million.
